# Gitea API

## Guide

- [Gitea API reference](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/introduction.md): A Sourcey-generated, navigable reference for the Gitea REST API, built from source at a pinned commit.
- [Coverage](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/coverage.md): What the pinned Gitea OpenAPI description actually contains, counted from the file.
- [Known gaps](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/gaps.md): Concrete, maintainer-facing gaps found in the pinned Gitea OpenAPI description, each reproducible from the file.

## API Reference

- [Gitea API](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api.md): This documentation describes the Gitea API.
- [Lists all jobs](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-actions-jobs-get.md): GET /admin/actions/jobs: returns ActionWorkflowJobsResponse.
- [Get all runners](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-actions-runners-get.md): GET /admin/actions/runners: returns ActionRunnersResponse.
- [Get a global actions runner registration token](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-actions-runners-registration-token-post.md): POST /admin/actions/runners/registration-token.
- [Get a global runner](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-actions-runners-runner-id-get.md): GET /admin/actions/runners/{runner_id}: returns ActionRunner.
- [Delete a global runner](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-actions-runners-runner-id-delete.md): DELETE /admin/actions/runners/{runner_id}.
- [Update a global runner](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-actions-runners-runner-id-patch.md): PATCH /admin/actions/runners/{runner_id}: takes EditActionRunnerOption, returns ActionRunner.
- [Lists all runs](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-actions-runs-get.md): GET /admin/actions/runs.
- [List cron tasks](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-cron-get.md): GET /admin/cron: returns a list of Cron.
- [Run cron task](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-cron-task-post.md): POST /admin/cron/{task}.
- [List all emails](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-emails-get.md): GET /admin/emails: returns a list of Email.
- [Search all emails](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-emails-search-get.md): GET /admin/emails/search: returns a list of Email.
- [List system's webhooks](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-hooks-get.md): GET /admin/hooks: returns a list of Hook.
- [Create a hook](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-hooks-post.md): POST /admin/hooks: takes CreateHookOption, returns Hook.
- [Get a hook](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-hooks-id-get.md): GET /admin/hooks/{id}: returns Hook.
- [Delete a hook](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-hooks-id-delete.md): DELETE /admin/hooks/{id}.
- [Update a hook](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-hooks-id-patch.md): PATCH /admin/hooks/{id}: takes EditHookOption, returns Hook.
- [List all organizations](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-orgs-get.md): GET /admin/orgs: returns a list of Organization.
- [List all packages](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-packages-get.md): GET /admin/packages.
- [List unadopted repositories](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-unadopted-get.md): GET /admin/unadopted.
- [Adopt unadopted files as a repository](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-unadopted-owner-repo-post.md): POST /admin/unadopted/{owner}/{repo}.
- [Delete unadopted files](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-unadopted-owner-repo-delete.md): DELETE /admin/unadopted/{owner}/{repo}.
- [Search users according filter conditions](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-get.md): GET /admin/users: returns a list of User.
- [Create a user](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-post.md): POST /admin/users: takes CreateUserOption, returns User.
- [Delete a user](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-username-delete.md): DELETE /admin/users/{username}.
- [Edit an existing user](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-username-patch.md): PATCH /admin/users/{username}: takes EditUserOption, returns User.
- [List a user's badges](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-username-badges-get.md): GET /admin/users/{username}/badges: returns a list of Badge.
- [Add a badge to a user](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-username-badges-post.md): POST /admin/users/{username}/badges: takes UserBadgeOption.
- [Remove a badge from a user](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-username-badges-delete.md): DELETE /admin/users/{username}/badges: takes UserBadgeOption.
- [Add a public key on behalf of a user](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-username-keys-post.md): POST /admin/users/{username}/keys: takes CreateKeyOption, returns PublicKey.
- [Delete a user's public key](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-username-keys-id-delete.md): DELETE /admin/users/{username}/keys/{id}.
- [Create an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-username-orgs-post.md): POST /admin/users/{username}/orgs: takes CreateOrgOption, returns Organization.
- [Rename a user](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-username-rename-post.md): POST /admin/users/{username}/rename: takes RenameUserOption.
- [Create a repository on behalf of a user](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-username-repos-post.md): POST /admin/users/{username}/repos: takes CreateRepoOption.
- [Returns a list of all gitignore templates](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-gitignore-templates-get.md): GET /gitignore/templates.
- [Returns information about a gitignore template](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-gitignore-templates-name-get.md): GET /gitignore/templates/{name}: returns GitignoreTemplateInfo.
- [Returns a list of all label templates](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-label-templates-get.md): GET /label/templates.
- [Returns all labels in a template](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-label-templates-name-get.md): GET /label/templates/{name}: returns a list of LabelTemplate.
- [Returns a list of all license templates](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-licenses-get.md): GET /licenses: returns a list of LicensesTemplateListEntry.
- [Returns information about a license template](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-licenses-name-get.md): GET /licenses/{name}: returns LicenseTemplateInfo.
- [Render a markdown document as HTML](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-markdown-post.md): POST /markdown: takes MarkdownOption.
- [Render raw markdown as HTML](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-markdown-raw-post.md): POST /markdown/raw.
- [Render a markup document as HTML](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-markup-post.md): POST /markup: takes MarkupOption.
- [List users's notification threads](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-notifications-get.md): GET /notifications.
- [Mark notification threads as read, pinned or unread](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-notifications-put.md): PUT /notifications.
- [Check if unread notifications exist](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-notifications-new-get.md): GET /notifications/new: returns NotificationCount.
- [Get notification thread by ID](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-notifications-threads-id-get.md): GET /notifications/threads/{id}.
- [Mark notification thread as read by ID](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-notifications-threads-id-patch.md): PATCH /notifications/threads/{id}.
- [Create a repository in an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-org-org-repos-post.md): POST /org/{org}/repos: takes CreateRepoOption.
- [Get list of organizations](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-get.md): GET /orgs: returns a list of Organization.
- [Create an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-post.md): POST /orgs: takes CreateOrgOption, returns Organization.
- [Get an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}: returns Organization.
- [Delete an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-delete.md): DELETE /orgs/{org}.
- [Edit an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-patch.md): PATCH /orgs/{org}: takes EditOrgOption, returns Organization.
- [Get org-level workflow jobs](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-jobs-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/actions/jobs: returns ActionWorkflowJobsResponse.
- [Get org-level runners](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-runners-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/actions/runners: returns ActionRunnersResponse.
- [Get an organization's actions runner registration token](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-runners-registration-token-post.md): POST /orgs/{org}/actions/runners/registration-token.
- [Get an org-level runner](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-runners-runner-id-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/actions/runners/{runner_id}: returns ActionRunner.
- [Delete an org-level runner](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-runners-runner-id-delete.md): DELETE /orgs/{org}/actions/runners/{runner_id}.
- [Update an org-level runner](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-runners-runner-id-patch.md): PATCH /orgs/{org}/actions/runners/{runner_id}: takes EditActionRunnerOption, returns ActionRunner.
- [Get org-level workflow runs](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-runs-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/actions/runs.
- [List an organization's actions secrets](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-secrets-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/actions/secrets: returns a list of Secret.
- [Create or Update a secret value in an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-secrets-secretname-put.md): PUT /orgs/{org}/actions/secrets/{secretname}: takes CreateOrUpdateSecretOption.
- [Delete a secret in an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-secrets-secretname-delete.md): DELETE /orgs/{org}/actions/secrets/{secretname}.
- [Get an org-level variables list](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-variables-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/actions/variables: returns a list of ActionVariable.
- [Get an org-level variable](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-variables-variablename-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/actions/variables/{variablename}: returns ActionVariable.
- [Create an org-level variable](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-variables-variablename-post.md): POST /orgs/{org}/actions/variables/{variablename}: takes CreateVariableOption.
- [Update an org-level variable](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-variables-variablename-put.md): PUT /orgs/{org}/actions/variables/{variablename}: takes UpdateVariableOption.
- [Delete an org-level variable](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-actions-variables-variablename-delete.md): DELETE /orgs/{org}/actions/variables/{variablename}: returns ActionVariable.
- [List an organization's activity feeds](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-activities-feeds-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/activities/feeds.
- [Update Avatar](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-avatar-post.md): POST /orgs/{org}/avatar: takes UpdateUserAvatarOption.
- [Delete Avatar](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-avatar-delete.md): DELETE /orgs/{org}/avatar.
- [List users blocked by the organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-blocks-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/blocks: returns a list of User.
- [Check if a user is blocked by the organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-blocks-username-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/blocks/{username}.
- [Block a user](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-blocks-username-put.md): PUT /orgs/{org}/blocks/{username}.
- [Unblock a user](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-blocks-username-delete.md): DELETE /orgs/{org}/blocks/{username}.
- [List an organization's webhooks](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-hooks-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/hooks: returns a list of Hook.
- [Create a hook](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-hooks-post.md): POST /orgs/{org}/hooks: takes CreateHookOption, returns Hook.
- [Get a hook](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-hooks-id-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/hooks/{id}: returns Hook.
- [Delete a hook](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-hooks-id-delete.md): DELETE /orgs/{org}/hooks/{id}.
- [Update a hook](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-hooks-id-patch.md): PATCH /orgs/{org}/hooks/{id}: takes EditHookOption, returns Hook.
- [List an organization's labels](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-labels-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/labels: returns a list of Label.
- [Create a label for an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-labels-post.md): POST /orgs/{org}/labels: takes CreateLabelOption, returns Label.
- [Get a single label](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-labels-id-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/labels/{id}: returns Label.
- [Delete a label](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-labels-id-delete.md): DELETE /orgs/{org}/labels/{id}.
- [Update a label](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-labels-id-patch.md): PATCH /orgs/{org}/labels/{id}: takes EditLabelOption, returns Label.
- [List an organization's members](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-members-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/members: returns a list of User.
- [Check if a user is a member of an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-members-username-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/members/{username}.
- [Remove a member from an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-members-username-delete.md): DELETE /orgs/{org}/members/{username}.
- [List an organization's projects](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/projects: returns a list of Project.
- [Create a project owned by an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-post.md): POST /orgs/{org}/projects: takes CreateProjectOption, returns Project.
- [Get a project](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/projects/{id}: returns Project.
- [Delete a project](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-delete.md): DELETE /orgs/{org}/projects/{id}.
- [Edit a project](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-patch.md): PATCH /orgs/{org}/projects/{id}: takes EditProjectOption, returns Project.
- [List a project's columns](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-columns-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/projects/{id}/columns: returns a list of ProjectColumn.
- [Create a column in a project](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-columns-post.md): POST /orgs/{org}/projects/{id}/columns: takes CreateProjectColumnOption, returns ProjectColumn.
- [Reorder a project's columns](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-columns-move-post.md): Reorders every column of the project at once. The body lists all column IDs in their new order.
- [Get a project column](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-columns-column-id-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/projects/{id}/columns/{column_id}: returns ProjectColumn.
- [Delete a project column](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-columns-column-id-delete.md): The default column cannot be deleted while it is still the column new issues land in.
- [Edit a project column](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-columns-column-id-patch.md): PATCH /orgs/{org}/projects/{id}/columns/{column_id}: takes EditProjectColumnOption, returns ProjectColumn.
- [Set a project's default column](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-columns-column-id-default-post.md): The default column is where newly assigned issues land.
- [List the issues in a project column](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-columns-column-id-issues-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/projects/{id}/columns/{column_id}/issues: returns a list of Issue.
- [Add an issue to a project column](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-columns-column-id-issues-issue-id-post.md): Assigns the issue to the project if it is not a member yet, then places it in the column.
- [Remove an issue from a project column](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-columns-column-id-issues-issue-id-delete.md): DELETE /orgs/{org}/projects/{id}/columns/{column_id}/issues/{issue_id}.
- [Move an issue between a project's columns](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-projects-id-issues-issue-id-move-post.md): POST /orgs/{org}/projects/{id}/issues/{issue_id}/move: takes MoveProjectIssueOption.
- [List an organization's public members](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-public-members-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/public_members: returns a list of User.
- [Check if a user is a public member of an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-public-members-username-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/public_members/{username}.
- [Publicize a user's membership](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-public-members-username-put.md): PUT /orgs/{org}/public_members/{username}.
- [Conceal a user's membership](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-public-members-username-delete.md): DELETE /orgs/{org}/public_members/{username}.
- [Rename an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-rename-post.md): POST /orgs/{org}/rename: takes RenameOrgOption.
- [List an organization's repos](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-repos-get.md): GET /orgs/{org}/repos.
- [Create a repository in an organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-repos-post.md): POST /orgs/{org}/repos: takes CreateRepoOption.
